title: Sanctuary
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Akira Hojo and Chiaki Asami survived the Cambodian killing fields as boys and vowed to remake Japan as their 'sanctuary'. Choosing roles by rock-paper-scissors, Hojo rises through the yakuza to unite the syndicates while Asami fights aging politicians to reach the Diet and become prime minister. Both use ruthless, often criminal means, and the series ends with their return to Cambodia and Asami's death from illness.
life_message: Bold young men willing to use any means, legal or not, can break a stagnant order and remake their nation.
